description: This file implements specialized scatter and gather operations for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend within the PyTorch project. It defines functions for scatter, scatter reduction, and gather operations optimized for MPS, using Metal graphs and tensors.

classes.name: CachedGraph
classes.description: A cache structure for compiled MPS graphs used in scatter and gather operations, storing input, index, src, and output tensors.

methods.name: gather_out_mps
methods.description: Executes a gather operation on MPS backend, gathering elements along a specified dimension.

methods.name: scatter_mps_general
methods.description: A generalized function implementing scatter and scatter reduction for MPS backends, supporting different reduction modes.

methods.name: scatter_src_out_mps
methods.description: Performs scatter with source tensor on MPS backend, filling specified output tensor.

methods.name: scatter_value_out_mps
methods.description: Performs scatter with a scalar value broadcasted into a tensor and places result into output tensor.

methods.name: scatter_reduce_out_mps
methods.description: Performs scatter reduction operation with a specified reduction mode on MPS backend.

methods.name: scatter_value_reduce_out_mps
methods.description: Performs scatter reduction with scalar value on MPS backend, for a specified reduction mode.

methods.name: scatter_add_mps_out
methods.description: Specialized scatter-add operation on MPS backend, accumulating updates into output tensor.
